scim.title: SCIM provisioning
scim.body: Your identity provider (Okta, Entra ID, Google Workspace, OneLogin) creates, updates and suspends people here as they change there.

ldap.title: LDAP or Active Directory
ldap.body: People sign in with their directory password, and are added here the first time they do.

off.title: Turn off {{name}}?
off.description: People can't sign in with their password from {{host}} until you turn it back on. Their accounts stay as they are.

delete.title: Delete {{name}}?
delete.description: People can no longer sign in with their password from {{host}}. Their accounts, groups and roles stay; anyone who signs in only this way needs another way in. Its sync history stays in Activity.

revoke.title: Revoke the SCIM token?
revoke.description_one: Your identity provider can no longer send changes here: new people, updates and suspensions stop until you give it a new token. The {{n}} person it created stays as they are.
revoke.description_other: Your identity provider can no longer send changes here: new people, updates and suspensions stop until you give it a new token. The {{n}} people it created stay as they are.

toast.testPassed: {{name}} works: Qeet ID signed in with its service account
toast.on: {{name}} is on: people can sign in with it

sync.exportTooLarge: That's over 10,000 rows. Choose a shorter period or one connection first.

activity.title: Sync activity
activity.description: Every change your identity provider sent over SCIM, every sign-in through LDAP, and every connection check.

band.syncedHow: Added, updated or removed over SCIM, or signed in through LDAP.

empty.title: No activity in the last {{days}} days
empty.description: A row appears each time your identity provider sends a change over SCIM, someone signs in through LDAP, or a connection is checked.

drawer.retryOf: A check run again from Sync errors

alert.title: Alert me when directories fail
alert.description: You get a notice in the console's notifications when failures reach a number within 15 minutes.
alert.name: Notice title
alert.onlyYou: Only you get it, at most once every 15 minutes
alert.onlyYouDetail: Failures include sign-ins a directory refuses, such as a mistyped password. An alert can't be changed or removed here yet.

errors.title: Sync errors
errors.description: What failed, grouped by cause, with what to do. A failure stays open until a check passes or someone marks it resolved.

readOnly.title: You can see the failures, not change them
readOnly.description: Checking again and marking resolved need the connection.write permission.

problem.ldapActive: People who sign in with it can't until it's fixed.
problem.ldapDraft: No one is affected yet: it's a draft.
problem.ldapOff: No one is affected: it's turned off.
problem.passed: The check passed. These failures are from before it: mark them resolved.
problem.healthy: It works again: its latest run in the last 24 hours succeeded. These failures are from before it: mark them resolved.

1.text: Qeet ID tried {{server}}. If the host name or port is wrong, correct it on the connection.

2.text: If the server is only on your network, open your firewall to Qeet ID on port {{port}}, and check the server's certificate is valid.

3.lead: Check the service account, then check again.
3.text: The check signs in with the connection's bind DN and password. A check that passes closes its failure.

1.text: A few now and then need nothing from you: the person tries again.

2.text: Test the connection on its page, and check its user filter finds exactly one entry for each person.

3.text: A sign-in is refused when a mapping marked Required finds nothing, or a mapping can't use a value.

exists.name: Already taken
exists.title_one: {{name}} sent a person or group that clashes with one already taken
exists.title_other: {{name}} sent {{n}} people or groups that clash with ones already taken

1.text: A group with that name or external ID is already here, or the person's email belongs to an account elsewhere or to a domain another organisation manages.

2.text: Rename the group here or in your identity provider, or give the person an email on one of your domains.

3.text: Retry the change from your identity provider, then mark this resolved.

notFound.name: Not found here
notFound.title_one: {{name}} changed a person or group that isn't here
notFound.title_other: {{name}} changed {{n}} people or groups that aren't here

1.text: The change named a person or group this organisation doesn't have; they may have been deleted here.

2.text: Unassign and reassign them in your identity provider, so it adds them afresh.

3.text: If they shouldn't be here, there's nothing else to do.

refusedData.name: Data refused
refusedData.title_one: Qeet ID refused a change from {{name}}

1.text: Each person needs a user name that's an email on a domain your organisation has verified.

2.text: A change is refused when a mapping marked Required finds nothing, or a mapping can't use a value.

3.text: Retry the change from your identity provider, then mark this resolved.

tooMany.name: Too many at once
tooMany.title_one: {{name}} sent a change faster than Qeet ID takes them
tooMany.title_other: {{name}} sent {{n}} changes faster than Qeet ID takes them

1.text: Qeet ID turned the changes away; nothing was saved from them.

2.text: Retry them from your identity provider.

3.text: Nothing else needs to change here.

denied.name: Not allowed
denied.title_one: {{name}} tried to change the organisation's owner
denied.title_other: {{name}} tried {{n}} times to change the organisation's owner

1.lead: The owner stays as they are.
1.text: The directory can't suspend or remove the account that owns the organisation.

2.text: Unassign the owner from Qeet ID in your identity provider.

3.text: Nothing else needs to change here.

failedHere.name: Failed in Qeet ID
failedHere.title_one: A change from {{name}} failed in Qeet ID
failedHere.title_other: {{n}} changes from {{name}} failed in Qeet ID

1.text: This failed on Qeet ID's side, not in your directory: retry it from your identity provider.

2.text: Contact Qeet ID support with the code and the time below.

empty.title: No failures in the last {{days}} days
empty.description: Everything your directories sent, every sign-in and every check went through.

drawer.retryElsewhere: Qeet ID can't send this again: retry it from your identity provider or the person's next sign-in. It doesn't keep what was sent, or anyone's password.

resolve.description: They leave To fix and the Sync errors count, and your name and the time are recorded. Nothing changes on the connection: if the cause is still there, the next failure is listed as a new one.

mappings.title: Mappings
mappings.description: Which directory attribute fills each Qeet ID field, for each connection.

readOnly.title: You can see the mappings, not change them
readOnly.description: Changing a mapping needs the connection.write permission.

none.title: No connections to map yet
none.description: Mappings belong to a connection: set up SCIM or connect a directory first.

connection.title: Connection
connection.scimHint: SCIM · sent by your identity provider
connection.draft: It's a draft: these mappings apply once it's turned on.
connection.disabled: It's turned off: no one signs in with it now.
connection.ldapOn: Applied each time someone signs in through it.
connection.scimOn: Applied to each change your identity provider sends.

fields.title: Profile fields
fields.descriptionLdap: Which directory attribute fills each field, each time someone signs in through this connection. Email and display name set the person's account; the rest are kept with their directory profile.
fields.descriptionScim: Which attribute fills each field, with each change your identity provider sends. Email and display name set the person's account; the rest are kept with their directory profile.

fromLdap.email: From the connection's settings. It finds or makes the account at the first sign-in, and doesn't change the email after.
fromLdap.display_name: From the connection's settings. It names new accounts; a mapping keeps the name up to date.

fromScim.email: What your identity provider sends as the user name.
fromScim.display_name: What your identity provider sends as the display name.

fields.groupsHint: Labels only: they don't add anyone to a group or grant access.
fields.offDefault: Turned off: the default, {{attribute}}, fills it.

editor.attributeLdap: An LDAP attribute name, such as departmentNumber.
editor.attributeScim: A SCIM attribute, or a path into the entry such as /name/givenName.
editor.patternHelp: A regular expression with one group in brackets: the part it captures is kept. ^([^@]+)@ keeps what comes before the @.
editor.requiredLdap: Refuse the sign-in when the directory doesn't send it.
editor.requiredScim: Refuse the change when your identity provider doesn't send it.
editor.enabledHelp: Turned off, it's kept but not applied.
editor.conflict: Someone changed this mapping meanwhile, or another mapping for this field is on. Reload the page and try again.
editor.full: A connection holds 50 mappings at most.

remove.title: Remove the {{field}} mapping?
remove.descriptionLdap: People keep what it set. From their next sign-in, {{field}} no longer comes from the directory attribute ‘{{attribute}}’.
remove.descriptionScim: People keep what it set. From the next change your identity provider sends, {{field}} no longer comes from the attribute ‘{{attribute}}’.

test.title: Test with a directory entry
test.description: Paste one entry from the directory, or edit this example, to see the profile the saved mappings make. Nothing is saved.
test.invalid: Enter one JSON object, under 64 KB.
test.refusedHint: A sign-in or change with this entry would be refused until these are fixed.
test.stale: The entry or the mappings changed since this test: run it again.

issues.preview_too_large: The test data or the mappings are too large to preview.
issues.source_invalid: The source attribute isn't a valid attribute name.
issues.source_credential: The source attribute names a credential, which can't be mapped.
issues.target_unsupported: This isn't a profile field that can be mapped.
issues.target_duplicate: Another active mapping already sets this field.
issues.value_type_mismatch: This field takes a different value type.
issues.pattern_unexpected: A pattern applies only to the extract transform.
issues.pattern_invalid: The pattern must be 1 to 256 characters with one capture group.
issues.source_missing: The required source attribute is missing from the test data.
issues.source_empty: The required source attribute is empty.
issues.value_not_string: The source value must be text.
issues.value_not_array: The source value must be a list of text values.
issues.value_too_long: A source value is longer than 2,048 characters.
issues.value_too_many: The source list has more than 100 entries.
issues.value_unmatched: The source value doesn't match the extract pattern.
issues.email_invalid: The mapped email isn't a valid address.
issues.display_name_too_long: The mapped display name is longer than 200 characters.
issues.unknown: This mapping can't be applied as configured.
